answer: Require every agent to stake a costly, non-transferable bond before it can transact — think of it as a marble each identity must hold, not borrow. The bond sits in escrow and is slashed on proven fraud, so spawning a nebula of fake identities means funding each one at full cost. An opal-like reputation ledger then decays staked credit for idle or cloned behavior, so an attacker pays the bond per identity yet earns nothing without real work.
